ai.rationale: Creative niche idea — AI-generated trash-talk battle cards for two DFS lineups, tied to a real-product thesis (BeatM) — and the pitch is specific enough to picture the UX. Loses heavily on completeness: both videoUrl AND deployedUrl are empty, so there's no way to verify the project actually shipped, and the brief explicitly required a live URL + explainer video. With either of those filled in this lands in the 6-7 range; with both missing it can't break into the solid tier.
